verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a government online service that handles employer and claimant records, so the axis applies. The pack only notes that incomplete UTR registrations stay accessible for up to one year (tx-twc-docs-2), which is a fixed retention period rather than a user control. It also mentions closing or reopening a tax account (tx-twc-docs-8), an adjacent account-status feature rather than data deletion. Nothing documents user-controlled retention settings or data deletion.
